description: The pitch for Sankan, from solo developer Dany Rexton of YTKA Games, intrigued me. "You and up to two friends work the night shift at a mountain gas station in Japan, 1999," he told me via email. "The voice in your head names a customer you have to kill. Do it, and you clean up the blood and bury the body before dawn. Refuse the voice, and it starts hunting you." And then I took a look at the moody, somewhat creepy trailer, complete with the built-in nostalgia of its PS1-era graphics, and I wanted to know more.
title: Sankan, a Co-op Horror Game Set at a Japanese Gas Station in 1999, Announced for PC
